en.name: Cranberry sauce, canned
en.summary: Canned cranberry sauce is a sugared, acidic fruit preserve, which is why an unopened can sits happily in the cupboard for about 2 years from purchase. Once opened it becomes a refrigerated leftover with about 1–2 weeks in it. Freezing is not recommended — it comes back watery.
en.pantry: An unopened can keeps about 2 years from purchase in a cool, dry cupboard, away from the hob and out of the sun. Sugar, acid and the sealed can do the preserving. Do not keep a can that is bulging, leaking, rusted through or badly dented along a seam — those indicate a failed seal, and nothing you do in the kitchen makes that safe again. Once the can is open, the cupboard is no longer an option.
en.fridge: Transfer opened cranberry sauce out of the can into a sealed container, keep it at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, and use it within about 1–2 weeks. Leaving it in the opened can gives it a metallic taste once air reaches the metal. Take out what you need with a clean spoon rather than serving from the storage container, and never return sauce from the table to the tub.
en.freezer: Freezing cranberry sauce is not recommended, as after thawing it may become too watery, and no freezer timeline is given for it. The pectin and sugar structure that makes jellied sauce hold its shape does not survive freezing and thawing. If you have too much after a holiday meal, the better answer is to use it — stirred into yoghurt, spread in a sandwich, or cooked down into a glaze — within the fridge window.
spoilage: A bulging, leaking or badly rusted can — discard it without opening
Mould on the surface or around the rim of the storage container
A fermented, yeasty or alcoholic smell
Liquid separating out with a fizzing or bubbling surface
tips: Decant into a sealed container the moment the can is opened.
Write the opening date on the container.
Serve from a separate bowl so the stored portion stays untouched.
Buy the can size that suits your table; a large can is no bargain if half goes to waste.

faq.q: How long does canned cranberry sauce last after opening?
faq.a: About 1–2 weeks in a sealed container in the fridge at 4 °C or below.
It is not recommended. After thawing it may become too watery, and no freezer timeline is given for it.

faq.q: How long does an unopened can of cranberry sauce keep?
faq.a: About 2 years from purchase in a cool, dry cupboard, as long as the can is undamaged.

faq.q: Can you store cranberry sauce in the opened can?
faq.a: No. Move it to a sealed container; once air reaches the metal the sauce picks up a tinny taste.

zh.name: 蔓越莓醬罐頭
zh.summary: 蔓越莓醬罐頭是加糖的酸性水果保存品，所以未開封的罐頭放在櫥櫃裡，從購買日起算大約 2 年都沒問題。一旦開罐，它就變成冷藏的剩食，大約 1～2 週。不建議冷凍——解凍後會變得太稀。
zh.pantry: 未開封的罐頭放在陰涼乾燥的櫥櫃、遠離爐火與日曬，從購買日起算大約 2 年。做保存工作的是糖、酸和密封的罐體。罐身鼓起、滲漏、鏽穿或接縫嚴重凹陷的都不要留——那代表密封失效，在廚房裡怎麼處理都救不回來。開罐之後，櫥櫃就不再是選項。
zh.fridge: 開罐後請把醬移出罐頭、裝進密封容器，放 4 °C 以下，並在大約 1～2 週內用完。留在開過的罐頭裡，空氣一接觸金屬就會讓它帶金屬味。用乾淨的湯匙取出要用的份量，不要直接從保存容器上桌取用，桌上剩下的也絕對不要倒回去。
zh.freezer: 蔓越莓醬不建議冷凍，因為解凍後可能變得太稀，官方也沒有給冷凍期限。讓凝凍型果醬維持形狀的果膠與糖的結構撐不過冷凍與解凍。過節後剩太多的話，更好的做法是在冷藏期限內用掉——拌優格、抹三明治，或熬成刷肉用的醬汁。
spoilage: 罐身鼓起、滲漏或嚴重生鏽——不要開，直接丟掉
醬面或保存容器邊緣長霉
聞起來有發酵味、酵母味或酒味
液體分離出來，表面冒泡或起氣
tips: 一開罐就立刻移到密封容器。
另外裝小碗上桌，保存的那份不要被動過。
依餐桌需求選罐頭大小；一半用不完的大罐不算划算。

faq.q: 蔓越莓醬罐頭開罐後可以放多久？
faq.a: 移到密封容器冷藏在 4 °C 以下，大約 1～2 週。
不建議。解凍後可能變得太稀，而且沒有提供冷凍期限。

faq.q: 未開封的蔓越莓醬罐頭可以放多久？
faq.a: 只要罐體完好，陰涼乾燥的櫥櫃從購買日起算大約 2 年。

faq.q: 可以直接把開過的罐頭放冰箱嗎？
faq.a: 不行。請移到密封容器；空氣接觸金屬後醬會帶金屬味。
